about_the_game:
"Wilbur has a meeting today—one he’s been waiting for with a quiet, particular kind of anticipation. His fiancée is expected to arrive in the lush garden by his estate. In the evening, when the air fills with the scent of damp earth and faded blossoms, they will sit together on the bench near the dry fountain and, as before, speak softly, almost in whispers, unaware of how time slips by.

Very soon, he’ll say something tender—perhaps the same words he spoke to her last May, or the winter before that.

Very soon… the illness will pass."

"Glassy stare" is the first story in a collection of visual novels, united by a dark, mysterious world, intense emotions, and vivid imagery.

- A visual novel with a deep, psychological narrative

- Unique visual style blending abstraction and symbolism

- Dark, atmospheric presentation with horror elements

- Poetic writing and meditative storytelling

- No complex mechanics: focus on mood, choices, and interpretation

content_descriptors.notes: This game touches on psychological themes
